bronze_male.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Workout Tracker sport mastery avatar. Generate exactly ONE fictional male Running athlete for the Bronze tier. Polished premium semi-realistic stylised 3D game-skin illustration, credible for ages 10 through adult; crisp face, natural athletic proportions, well-defined hands and believable equipment. Original character, not a real athlete or celebrity. Character identity: deep brown skin; soft square jaw; hazel eyes; short black coils with high fade; tall lean long-legged build. Visibly junior athlete, approximately 12–14, natural youthful face and proportions, modest practical kit; no adult musculature or jewellery. Collection palette: vermillion, slate and pearl. This tier's outfit below determines the current colours. Outfit: Technical short-sleeve running top and shorts. Basic junior-sized kit with simple construction. Equipment: Light running shoes; discreet running watch from Gold; no race numbers. Award: None Pose: relaxed feet apart; preserve the stated tier age and a readable unobstructed face. Tier silhouette direction: Relaxed introductory three-quarter view; natural asymmetrical weight distribution and curious expression. Establish the junior identity without a stiff catalogue stance. Square portrait. Entire head, hands, equipment and both feet visible, centred with 6–8% clear transparent margins. Athlete occupies roughly 80–88% of canvas height; trophies fit naturally inside the frame. Keep face and torso unobstructed. Match the rendering finish and proportions of the supplied style reference, but follow this tier's kit and award brief. Keep the corresponding male and female tier equal in prestige, award scale, kit quality and visual presence. Create a real transparent background with clean alpha edges. No words, lettering, numbers, brand or team logos, watermark, border, background scene, extra people, unrelated weapons, fantasy armour, wings, magic, neon aura or trophy clutter. Bronze has no award. Do not invent extra medals or accessories. No copied official trophy inscriptions. Preserve recognisable eye shape, skin tone and hair character, while visibly ageing the same fictional person. Do not preserve the junior face proportions in adult tiers. Mature facial structure, natural eye-to-face proportions, a developed nose/jaw and less rounded cheeks must make Platinum onward unmistakably adult in BOTH appearances; do not rely on muscles, makeup, a beard, suit or trophies to signal age. Styling stays polished and semi-realistic, with no oversized doll eyes or baby-faced adult. Pose references supply equipment/kit only: do not duplicate their stance, hand placement, body angle or expression across tiers. The sport is this individual's story, not a demographic stereotype or a restriction that this person can only play one sport.

Sport-specific constraints: Same fictional individual visibly ages across the eight tiers. Original practice/participation recognition, not proof of professional rank, competitive titles, medical or teaching qualifications. Both appearances have equal coverage, stature, kit quality and award scale. Unreal uses equally refined formal trouser suits for both; omit sport equipment. No competition numbers, words, brands, official medals or copied trophies. Avoid repeated template anatomy across sports; individual build does not imply ability or demographic association.

Input image 1 is rendering-finish reference ONLY. Create a distinct new Running identity exactly as described; do not copy the reference face, hairstyle, pose, football kit or equipment. Use vermillion top, slate shorts and pearl running shoes. No watch at Bronze.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION: zoomed-out full-body figure on a SQUARE canvas. Top of hair at y=100 pixels and bottom of shoes at y=1150 pixels on a1254 square. The figure is 84% of image height, leaving at least8% EMPTY TRANSPARENT SPACE above AND below. Do not match reference scale. Entire athlete appears smaller within canvas, no clipping.
